ACCURACY-RESULTS.md.content:
# K64 QK precision: advance one native block numerical gate

Root operator window44495: four jobs passed. Six operator cells = three unique saved native QKV histories × original QK-only/K64. Both repeats exact, all outputs finite, canaries intact. No timing was performed.

| History | Scalar RNE mismatches | QK-only | K64 | QK-only max-stat error | K64 max-stat error |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 7.263e-06 | 1.94e-06 |
| 1 | 0 | 1 | 0 | 4.756e-06 | 8.745e-07 |
| 2 | 1 | 1 | 0 | 6.777e-06 | 9.382e-07 |

K64 matches all 24,576 independently rounded reference BF16 words. It corrects the two original QK-only words where scalar was closer to FP64 and retains the one changed scalar word where QK was closer. Split maxima absolute errors shrink 3.7–7.2×; normalized partial relative errors remain roughly 6e-8 and are mixed rather than uniformly improved. Old QK DSO output AND raw Opart/MLpart match the previously captured broad interpreter exactly.

The native-scalar attention relative L2 becomes 0 / 0 / 1.0914e-8, versus 0 / 5.5787e-6 / 2.2352e-5. Aggregate FP64 output relative L2 is dominated by BF16 quantization and changes negligibly.

Release gpu-block-ready.json only for the existing block5 numerical capture. Explicit validate-block.py reuses the existing capture loader, fixed .003 attention and .01 block thresholds plus original absolute bound; checks six rows, exact inputs and resets, and exact agreement with the already qualified same-input K64 DSO output. Original gpu-block-held.json remains unchanged.

Limits: one synthetic-prefix block, only 2/3/4 distinct V rows in the three histories; not a full-network attention capture. Original E1 full-model numerical failure remains open. K64 operator resources rise 239→254 registers; no speed benefit is claimed. Broad remains 255 registers with spills. No further precision alternatives built.

# K64 native block numerical result

Root capture window78102 completed; explicit validator passed all six rows. K64 block act.x is byte-exact to native scalar on all three unique histories and their reset repeats. Original QK-only block relative L2 was 0 / .00103924 / .00174817.

Q/K/V and lengths are exact. Broad attention output matches the independently replayed K64 operation body byte-for-byte. Attention relative L2 against scalar is 0 / 0 / 1.0914e-8: its one retained changed BF16 word matches the independently rounded float64 result. It produces no changed block output words on this fixture.

This qualifies bounded native block accuracy, not speed or full-network quality. The original full-network gate remains unresolved. No performance timing has been performed for K64; its higher operation-body register count may cost performance.
